name: Hitch a Hike
desc:
Your car broke down on route 0, the weirdest road on earth. Route 0 is known for weird entities, strange people, and dangerous situations. The nearest town is 2000 kilometers away. Hitch hike your way there, avoiding dangerous people along the way. Be careful as you're always being hunted...
